problem.title: You have traction but your website still looks MVP
problem.description: There's a gap between how your product looks and how you present it

issue1.title: People don't understand what you do
issue1.description: If your website and marketing aren't crystal clear, potential customers won't get what you do or why it matters.

issue2.title: You look amateur and like you're still testing
issue2.description: First impressions matter. A DIY or unpolished design makes users bounce 127% faster, even if your product is solid.

issue3.title: Your site isn't built to convert
issue3.description: You've got a good product and decent traction. Now it's time for your page structure and messaging to work as hard as you do.

intro.text1: If that sounds like your situation, We can help.
intro.text2: DigitiNexus is a design-driven web agency that blends creativity, strategy, and technology to craft websites that truly stand out.
intro.text3: Every project we build doesn't just look beautiful — it performs beautifully too.

step1.title: Book a quick call
step1.description: We start with a quick call to understand your goals, audience, and priorities. No commitments + you'll know what to do next.

step2.title: Design & Development
step2.description: We explore ideas, create moodboards, and align on visual identity and tone. We build your website with constant updates.

step3.title: Launch, build trust, convert more
step3.description: We go live and monitor your site's performance, offering post-launch support and optimization.

feature1.title: A Curated Network of Experts
feature1.description: Every project is built around the right people. From motion and 3D designers to developers and brand strategists, we assemble a custom team that fits your goals, industry, and creative vision.

feature2.title: Animation Pro
feature2.description: We use advanced motion design to turn static pages into immersive experiences that elevate your brand's presence.

feature3.title: Conversion-Driven Design
feature3.description: We design with purpose, combining visual excellence and strategic thinking to build websites that attract, engage, and convert.

feature4.title: Tailored to Your Industry
feature4.description: Whether you run a restaurant, a professional practice, or a creative studio, we adapt our process to your tone, audience, and business needs.

feature5.title: Mobile-First by Design
feature5.description: We design from mobile upward, optimizing layouts, speed, and interactions for the devices people use most. This ensures a seamless, fast, and high-converting experience across all screens.

feature6.title: Built for the Long Run
feature6.description: Our relationships don't end at launch. We stay close to our clients with ongoing updates, creative refinements, and proactive support to keep their websites growing and performing over time.

q1.question: What services do you offer?
q1.answer1: We design and develop complete websites, from strategy and branding to design and launch.
q1.answer2: Whether you need a site for your restaurant, your studio, or your creative brand, we tailor every project to your goals.
q1.answer3: Already have a design? We can handle development and optimization too.

q2.question: How long does it take?
q2.answer1: Most projects take between 2 and 6 weeks, depending on the number of pages, content readiness, and level of customization.
q2.answer2: Smaller sites (like professional studios) are usually ready in a few weeks, while more creative or interactive builds may take longer.

q3.question: Do you also handle branding?
q3.answer: Yes. Many of our clients start from scratch, so we offer brand identity design — logo, color palette, typography, and a mini style guide — to ensure a consistent, professional image across all touchpoints.

q4.question: Do you work only with certain industries?
q4.answer1: We specialize in restaurants, professional studios, and creative businesses, but we also collaborate with service-based companies and startups.
q4.answer2: Our approach adapts to your tone, audience, and industry needs.

q5.question: What makes DigitiNexus different from other agencies?
q5.answer1: Every project gets a custom-built team of designers, developers, and motion or 3D artists, hand-picked to execute your vision.
q5.answer2: We combine beautiful design with real strategy, so your site will not only look great but also convert visitors into clients.

q6.question: What happens after launch?
q6.answer1: We don't disappear once your website is live.
q6.answer2: We offer continuous support, design improvements, and updates to keep your site fast, secure, and relevant as your business grows.
